observed_contract: runAgentSubagents reads persisted task state with store.get() before claiming it
if the task is not done/running/uncertain it later calls markRunning()
markRunning() is a blind patch and does not assert the previously observed status
batch-store transaction is read-modify-write without an inter-process lock or compare-and-set token
race: Two independent processes or duplicate deliveries using the same stable batchId/taskId can both observe pending/failed before either markRunning call, both mark the task running, and both start provider/tool work. Persisted uncertain/restart protection therefore does not itself provide a single-executor claim.
required_fix_contract: claim a persisted task atomically across processes before any provider or local tool work
claim must check an expected prior status instead of blindly overwriting it with running
a losing contender must not execute the task and must surface the durable running/uncertain/done state
serialization must be inter-process; a JavaScript in-memory mutex alone is insufficient
crash recovery of the claim mechanism must remain fail-closed and must not turn an uncertain prior execution into an automatic replay
scope: Independent integration/restart safety finding. No Qwen product file was changed.
